title: Owner exception to a review finding
description: The owner's decision on one finding of the latest review of a feature or a planning: the finding is not applicable, or its risk is accepted. A feature record (kind feature, or no kind: the records written before the field existed) excepts a critical or major finding; it is written by scripts/record-exception.sh, or by scripts/triage-review.sh --decisions when the owner accepts or defers such a finding, and published on the Issue. A planning record (kind planning) is the owner's decision on a minor finding that the planner escalated, written by scripts/finish-planning.sh --resolve; a planning review has no Issue, so the planning approval lists it instead. Each is stored as .agents/exceptions/<review-basename>-<finding-id>.json after the owner confirmed exactly this content at a terminal; Git ignores it. It is valid only while the review artifact has review_sha256, is the latest round, and is current for the content (its reviewed_tree), and while every field agrees with that review; it never carries forward to a changed tree or a later round. A feature record lets finish-feature.sh commit the feature with that finding open, never changes the review or its verdict, satisfies no acceptance criterion, and always makes the merge need the owner's approval. The account is the GitHub login that ran the script; until the template's Issue #99 gives the agent an identity of its own, it is not checked against the owner's identity.

kind.description: The kind of the review. Absent: feature, as for the records written before the field existed.

type.description: not-applicable: the finding is wrong or does not apply, and evidence shows why. risk-accepted: the finding is valid and the owner accepts its risk, named in the reason.

evidence.description: What shows that the finding is wrong: required for a not-applicable feature record, optional (null) otherwise.

account.description: The GitHub login that ran the script that recorded it (gh api user).

directed_at.description: When the owner confirmed it, UTC.

review.description: The review artifact, relative to the repository root.

review_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the review artifact when the exception was recorded.

finding_severity.description: critical or major for a feature record; minor for a planning record (an escalated minor finding).

reviewed_tree.description: Copied from the review: the content the exception is bound to.

planner_rationale.description: A planning record only: why the planner escalated the finding.
